description: Per-API HTTP input, DynamoDB operations (input/output), and HTTP response data shape for task-service implemented endpoints.

indexes.CarePlanIndex: LSI on lsi1Sk — patient PK queries filtered by care plan
indexes.StaffPatientTasksIndex: GSI1 on gsi1Pk + gsi1Sk — staff inbox

TaskMetaDdbRecord.description: Full META row as returned by Query/GetItem (persistence shape)

currentState.note: legacy active/scheduled stored in DDB; normalized to open on HTTP read

RuntimeTaskCard.description: META projected for HTTP list/detail — all TaskMetaDdbRecord fields except pk, sk, entityType, lsi1Sk, gsi1Pk, gsi1Sk, idempotencyKey, generationHash, version

PatientTaskListData.description: GET /tasks response data object (inside ApiResponse envelope)

POST /tasks/monitoring-action.purpose: Create a monitoring-runtime task (idempotent natural key). Caller: Monitoring Runtime.

body.assignedToStaffId: string (required when assignedToType is not patient)
body.assignedToStaffDisplayName: string (required when assignedToType is not patient)

databaseOperations.name: resolveMeta
databaseOperations.when: LOOKUP exists for same org (idempotent replay)

output.item: TaskMetaDdbRecord — returned as existing task, no writes
output.notFound: treat as missing, proceed to create

output.success: returns META record from Put item 1
output.TransactionCanceledException: re-run resolve; if same-org META found → skippedDuplicate

POST /tasks/generate-care-plan.purpose: Batch-create care-plan linkage tasks (idempotent per linkage). Caller: Care Plan Runtime.
POST /tasks/generate-care-plan.idempotentScope: per linkage in sourceLinkageContext.linkages[] — processed sequentially; first 409 aborts entire request

linkageItem.assignedToStaffId: string (required when assignedToType is not patient)
linkageItem.assignedToStaffDisplayName: string (required when assignedToType is not patient)

resolvedServerSide.createdBy: system:care-plan-runtime OR system:care-plan-runtime:<actorId> when actorId in body
resolvedServerSide.runtimeTaskInstanceId: rtask-<sha256-prefix-32> per linkage from idempotency key

idempotencyKey.scope: one key per linkage (not per HTTP request)

databaseOperations.name: perLinkage
databaseOperations.note: prepareAssignedToTypeInput normalizes each linkage before keys/build

httpResultItem.outcome: created (always — no idempotency check on dry run)

databaseOperations.name: resolveMeta
databaseOperations.when: LOOKUP exists for same org (idempotent replay for this linkage)

output.item: TaskMetaDdbRecord — append to results as skippedDuplicate, no writes for this linkage

output.success: returns META record — linkage result outcome created
output.TransactionCanceledException: re-run resolve; if same-org META found → skippedDuplicate for linkage

operationSummary.dryRunFalseNewLinkage: GetItem LOOKUP (miss) + TransactWrite Put×3 per linkage
operationSummary.dryRunFalseReplay: GetItem LOOKUP + GetItem META per linkage (no writes)
operationSummary.multiLinkageBatch: N linkages → up to 2N Gets + up to 3N Puts (only for new linkages)

statusCodes.200: all linkages processed (mix of created and skippedDuplicate allowed)
statusCodes.409: IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_USE (any linkage cross-org conflict aborts whole batch)

GET /tasks.purpose: Patient-scoped task list for care UI — one DynamoDB page split into patientTasks and staffTasks buckets. Read-only.

query.staffUserId: string (optional — required to populate staffTasks for a specific nurse on this patient chart)
query.carePlanInstanceId: string (optional — switches query to CarePlanIndex LSI)
query.currentState: open | scheduled | active | completed | missed | dismissed | cancelled (optional)

databaseOperations.name: queryPatientTasksPage
databaseOperations.note: Single query per HTTP request — pagination token applies to raw DDB page before in-memory split

variants.name: defaultDueDateSort

input.FilterExpression: entityType = :metaEntity [AND workflowStage = :workflowStage] [AND currentState = :currentState] [OR terminal exclusion when currentState omitted]
input.terminalExclusionWhenNoCurrentState: currentState <> completed AND <> missed AND <> dismissed AND <> cancelled

variants.sortOrder: sk ascending (due date order via DUE#<ms13> prefix)

output.items: TaskMetaDdbRecord[] — see schemas.TaskMetaDdbRecord for all fields
output.lastEvaluatedKey: DynamoDB cursor encoded as HTTP nextToken

bucketSplit.patientTasks: assignedToType === patient (includes monitoring + care-plan patient linkages)
bucketSplit.staffTasks: assignedToType === orgStaff AND assignedToStaffId === staffUserId — only when staffUserId query param is set
bucketSplit.omitted: orgStaff rows not matching staffUserId appear in neither bucket; without staffUserId param staffTasks is always empty

postDbProcessing.wireNormalization: legacy currentState active/scheduled → open; legacy assignedToType staff → orgStaff
postDbProcessing.sort: dueWindowStart ascending within each bucket (re-sorted after split)
postDbProcessing.pagination: one nextToken for underlying query — both buckets are slices of the same DDB page

operationSummary.withPagination: 1× Query per page until client exhausts nextToken

statusCodes.400: VALIDATION_ERROR — missing patientId or invalid enum/pageSize

workflowScenario.title: Care coordinator opens Maria's chart
actors: Nurse Patel viewing Maria's onboarding tasks
workflowScenario.precondition: Maria has tasks from generate-care-plan + monitoring-action (Stories 1–2)
flow: DynamoDB Query on ORG#org-acme-001#PAT#pat-maria-88201 begins_with DUE# with workflowStage filter
DDB returns META rows: 2 patient tasks + 1 staff task (+ monitoring task if in stage)
Service puts patient-assigned rows in patientTasks, Patel's staff row in staffTasks
UI renders patient checklist and nurse's assigned call side-by-side on same chart

POST /tasks.purpose: Ad-hoc / service-flow / manual runtime task create (non-idempotent).

attributes.currentState: scheduled if future dueWindowStart else open

GET /tasks/{runtimeTaskInstanceId}.purpose: Single task detail with optional related records.

output.note: org scope check same as GET detail

PUT /tasks/{runtimeTaskInstanceId}/assig.purpose: Initial staff assignment or reassignment for orgStaff tasks.

items.firstAssignment: SET assignedToStaffId, assignedToStaffDisplayName, gsi1Pk, gsi1Sk, lastUpdatedAt, lastUpdatedBy
items.reassignment: SET assignedToStaffId, assignedToStaffDisplayName, gsi1Pk, lastUpdatedAt, lastUpdatedBy (gsi1Sk unchanged)

GET /staff/tasks.purpose: Staff inbox — tasks assigned via GSI1. staffUserId must match JWT custom:userID.

input.FilterExpression: entityType = :metaEntity [AND patientId] [AND carePlanInstanceId] [AND currentState] [AND terminal exclusion]

GET /action-center/items.purpose: Patient Action Center with server-derived surfaceSection.

query.surfaceSection: today | upcoming | needsAttention | history | carePlanChecklist | all (required)

input.FilterExpression: entityType = RuntimeTaskInstance AND displayToPatient = true AND assignedToType = patient

data.allSections: { patientId, timezone, sections: { today, upcoming, needsAttention, history, carePlanChecklist }, nextToken }

POST /tasks/{runtimeTaskInstanceId}/stat.purpose: Manual state transition with optimistic concurrency and audit trail.

items.when: toState is completed | dismissed | cancelled | missed
items.UpdateExpression: SET reminderHistory (cancel open entries) [, evidenceSummary for completed/missed]

databaseOperations.name: publishCancelReminderJobs
databaseOperations.note: when terminal transition cancelled scheduled reminders

GET /care-plans/{carePlanInstanceId}/tas.purpose: Care-plan stage readiness aggregate (computed read, not persisted).

input.pagination: up to 20 rounds × 200 items until exhausted

data.incompleteRequiredTasks: array of { runtimeTaskInstanceId, displayTitle, requiredForStageCompletion, currentState }
